_comment: Russian species names applied by build_species.py after eBird (locale=ru), Wikidata and IOC Multilingual (step ioc_names): {slug: {"ru": name or null, "source": ...}}; null removes a wrong name. Attested names: eBird names with an obvious typo fixed, the title of the ru.wikipedia article about the species (checked via Wikidata sitelinks, 2026-09-27), a ru.wikipedia link label, or an IOC 15.2 name; plus names with source "constructed" (see below). Every name is also normalised in code: first letter upper case, names without Cyrillic letters (Latin binomials in Wikidata labels) dropped. Species checked with no ru.wikipedia article under a Russian title (left null at the time; most now have an IOC or constructed name, see below): atlapetes-schistaceus, grallaria-saturata, grallaria-saltuensis, grallaria-quitensis, grallaria-alvarezi (article title is Latin), grallaria-alticola, dubusia-taeniata (article is titled with the genus, «Дюбузия»), tephrophilus-wetmorei, coeligena-bonapartei, heliangelus-clarisse, dacnis-egregia, myiothlypis-chlorophrys, rallus-aequatorialis (article title is Latin), atlapetes-crassus. Audit of 27.09 (second batch; eBird has no ru name, ru.wikipedia article absent or titled in Latin, left null): troglodytes-musculus, tyto-furcata (article «Tyto furcata»), cyphorhinus-dichrous, contopus-bogotensis, rhynchocyclus-aequinoctialis, gygis-candida, deconychura-pallida, myiopagis-cinerea, myiopagis-parambae, xenops-genibarbis, xenops-mexicanus, basileuterus-delattrii (article «Basileuterus delattrii»), phacellodomus-inornatus, acrochordopus-zeledoni, amaurospiza-aequatorialis, laniisoma-buckleyi, formicivora-intermedia (article «Formicivora intermedia»), setophaga-aestiva, chlorothraupis-frenata, automolus-virgatus, tunchiornis-ferrugineifrons, pachyramphus-salvini, furnarius-cinnamomeus (article «Furnarius cinnamomeus»), polioptila-bilineata, tolmomyias-viridiceps, cryptopipo-litae, ocreatus-peruanus. eBird ru names used as is: oxyura-ferruginea «Андская савка», mionectes-galbinus «Оливковый тираннчик» (eBird spells the whole genus «тираннчик»), lophornis-verreauxii «Кокетка-бабочка», zimmerius-parvus «Малый москитолов», larus-smithsonianus «Американская чайка» (ru.wikipedia: «Американская серебристая чайка»), myiodynastes-hemichrysus «Златобрюхий бентеви», myiobius-sulphureipygius «Желтогузый широкохвост». Batch 1 of 28.09 (30 route species without an eBird/Wikidata name; owner approved): 19 came through step ioc_names; overrides added only for the rest. setophaga-petechia «Мангровая древесница» per IOC 15.2 (IOC gives «Жёлтая древесница», the ru.wikipedia title of the old broad species, to S. aestiva, which gets it through step ioc_names). forpus-crassirostris «Прибрежный попугайчик»: link label in ru.wikipedia «Воробьиные попугайчики» (IOC cell empty, species article titled in Latin). CONSTRUCTED names (no attested Russian name found in eBird ru, IOC 15.2 or ru.wikipedia; built from the English name and the parent species' Russian name; NEED A REVIEWER, e.g. against Бёме & Флинт): troglodytes-musculus, grallaria-alticola, grallaria-saturata, polioptila-bilineata, saltator-olivascens, basileuterus-delattrii, herpsilochmus-frater, hellmayrea-gularis (IOC 15.2 gives it «Короткохвостая иглохвостка», the name of Synallaxis brachyura, almost certainly an IOC copy error), tunchiornis-ferrugineifrons, myiopagis-cinerea.
